body.text:
Instead of focusing on what AI can't do, what if we asked what more we could do with it?
Working with AI is an art. Knowing when to use it, when not to, and how to actually collaborate with it — that's a soft skill, and a new one that everyone, intern or senior, needs to learn to stay sharp.
Not everything should be handed off. There's work I want to keep for myself, work that needs a human in the loop. That's exactly why I lean on AI for everything else - so I have room to do more of it.
Try @asana to seamlessly collaborate with your colleagues — and your newly onboarded AI Teammates.
#ai #AsanaPartner

body.text:
AI has made individual PMs faster. But most product launches still break at the coordination layer — the status updates that don’t happen, the timelines nobody mapped to the actual go-live, the prioritization calls that get buried in Slack.

These are the 3 Asana AI Teammates I’d actually build into every launch. Each one takes a concrete action inside the workflow — drafting executive updates, building milestone timelines from the go-live back, recommending priority based on real strategic alignment — so the whole team stays coordinated, not just the individuals.

This is what it looks like when humans and AI Teammates run a workflow together. 🗂️
